features: DATABASE CHANGES: TEN MIGRATIONS AND TWO SETTINGS MIGRATIONS, TWO OF THEM WRITE DATA — The update runs ten new migrations and two settings migrations by itself. New structures: the financial statement's summary note and its versions, the debt recovery rules, the calendar and default of the repayment agreement, the replies to Inbox tasks (with one checkbox in the six-month exemptions), each condominium's settings, a label on instalment plans for the personal-charge plans; and a document's author can now stay empty, so deleting a user no longer deletes the documents they created («utente eliminato», deleted user). Two migrations write data: one creates the Inbox task for every report that is already open or in progress (running it again creates no duplicates), the other realigns the instalments that the owner had reported from the portal and that stayed «in verification» even though their task was closed (they become paid, partly paid or due again, as the recorded payment says). Of the two settings migrations, one adds the handwritten legal rate, which starts empty; the other changes nothing for anyone updating. No new permission; requirements are unchanged. After updating, reload any pages that are already open.

CHANGED: THE ORDER OF PAYMENTS — When a payment does not say what it is for, the program proposes paying first the interest and charges billed to that person that are already due or due today, then the instalments from the oldest; with «Scelta da te» (your choice) you choose otherwise. If the person has a repayment agreement in progress, the instalments and charges that the agreement covers leave the proposed order, for the part covered: a payment with no instructions goes to the current instalments, and the declaration «Versamento dell'accordo» (agreement payment) sends it to the agreement's instalments first. Money that lands on the agreement's instalments counts for the agreement even without the declaration; on an instalment only partly covered, without the declaration it goes first to the part outside the agreement. The receipt lists interest and charges in the same order.

CHANGED: THE SETTLEMENT WHEN A PERSON HAS SEVERAL ROLES ON THE SAME UNIT — If the same person is, in the same year, owner and tenant of the same unit for different periods, the «Conguaglio» (settlement) tab and the prints give the days per role («306 days as owner») instead of a single figure. Amounts already paid for a unit that no plan has used go on nobody's sheet even when only the tenant changes (in the management where the tenant pays a share): the tab says so, with «a chi va lo decidi tu» (you decide who gets it).

CHANGED: «DISPONIBILE OGGI» AND THE «CASSA» TAB — In the treasury of the condominium dashboard the box says «Disponibile oggi» (available today): movements dated in the future do not enter today's figure (they enter the 30 days, on their day; the opening balances of cash accounts do), and «Da dove viene» (where it comes from) lists the cash accounts and the funds that cannot be used, with their amounts. In the financial statement the «Cassa» tab closes each bank account with the balance the bank shows, with the funds held inside it below («di cui…», which do not add to the total), the type of each fund (generic, tied to works, severance pay, arrears, released by the assembly) and the «Si può usare» (can be used) line. The accounting ledger can be filtered by cash account and «Come è composta» (how it is made up) shows the parts of the figure. The «Casse reali sotto zero» (real cash accounts below zero) check looks at the account with its funds inside; if only the free part goes below zero, it says so as a separate notice.

CHANGED: THE PERSON'S ACCOUNT STATEMENT — The header has «Guida» (guide) and the «Azioni» (actions) menu (letters, charges, prints); there is a sixth card, «Addebiti personali» (personal charges), with the total and the buttons «Nuovo» (new) and «Spese del ritardo» (late-payment costs, formerly «Addebita una spesa»); the letters have a card in the right column; with many units the card shows the first two and «e altre N unità» (and N more units).

CHANGED: PAGES OF THE MANAGEMENT AREA — The condominium selector in the header has the «Cerca condominio…» (search condominium) field and scrolls inside its panel. «Guida completa» looks like the «Guida» button on the eight pages that use it. «Rate scadute» (overdue instalments) has its three cards at the top («Chi deve pagare», «Lettere e azioni», «Le regole»), and the list buttons sit on one row, with «Dispense dei sei mesi» next to «Guida». «Incassi» and «Ricevute»: the buttons do not wrap, «Ricevute» has the way back to «Incassi», a guide with three cards, filter menus and the actions on the selection on one row. After printing, the receipts selection is cleared, as after sending by email. «Incasso da terzi» has its own guide. The guide of the «Saldi iniziali» (opening balances) explains «Dichiara l'origine del pregresso, in blocco» (declare the origin of the arrears, in bulk).

CHANGED: THE DASHBOARD OF A LARGE CONDOMINIUM IS LIGHTER — The totals of the budget coverage are computed in the database instead of loading the shares one by one: the figures are the same, and a condominium with thousands of people uses far less memory.

NEW: THE FINANCIAL STATEMENT SUMMARY NOTE — The financial statement has a «Nota sintetica» tab with the five parts of the explanatory note: «I criteri del rendiconto» (the statement's criteria), «La gestione dell'anno» (the year's management), «I rapporti in corso» (ongoing relationships), «Le questioni pendenti» (pending matters) and «Altre informazioni» (other information). The program proposes the facts it knows from the accounts (for example the accrual and cash criteria, the funds, arrears with the total, the people and the age bands, never the names, and the percentage of unpaid instalments out of the overdue ones): for each one you keep, remove or rewrite it, and add your own text. What the program does not know you write yourself: contracts, policies and periodic inspections, employees, matters to decide at the assembly, pending lawsuits, challenged resolutions, open insurance claims and certain debts; «no lawsuit» is your declaration, never a sentence the program adds by itself. The note is printed as the first part of the booklet; if it is missing, the cover page tells the owners that the booklet does not contain it.

NEW: «GENERA LA NOTA», THE FIRM'S TEXTS AND COPYING — For those in a hurry, «Genera la nota» (generate the note) keeps all the proposed facts, copies the texts and lists from the previous year and says what is missing. It invents nothing: the declaration on lawsuits, challenges and claims and the employees line copied from another note stay «da confermare» (to be confirmed) and are not printed until you confirm them. Every «Genera la nota» leaves a line in the note's log, with who, when and what was missing. «Copia dall'anno prima» (copy from the previous year) and «Copia da un altro condominio» (copy from another condominium) bring texts and lists, never facts; from another condominium the contracts arrive without amount and expiry date. «Salva come testo dello studio» (save as a firm text) keeps a text in the text library, for all condominiums or just one.

NEW: THE FINANCIAL STATEMENT KEPT WITH ITS VERSIONS — In the Summary, «Ferma per l'assemblea» (freeze for the assembly) keeps a version of the financial statement: its number, that day's figures, the note as it was and the booklet's PDF (if the booklet is too large for a single PDF, the parts are kept one by one or you upload the PDF you sent). When the assembly approves, «Registra l'approvazione» (record the approval) asks for the resolution date, the minutes number, the minutes and whether the assembly also approved the allocation statement (yes or no, with no default answer); a second approval makes the first one «sostituita» (replaced). «Elimina la versione» (delete the version) applies to a frozen version that was never approved, and removes its PDF. A financial year or a condominium with a frozen statement cannot be deleted, and the refusal says which version it is. At the top of every tab, the statement's status; after the approval, if the accounts have changed, a notice with the figures of then and of today, «Vedi che cosa è cambiato» (see what changed) and «Ferma una versione nuova» (freeze a new version): nothing is blocked, because whether it is a mistake or a later expense is for you to know.

NEW: THE BANK BALANCE CHECK — The financial statement has fifteen checks. The new one compares the balance the bank shows on its statement (you write it in the summary note, with the date, for each account) with the balance recorded in KondoManager on the same date. Without the balance written it says «non calcolato» (not calculated) and leads to «Scrivi il saldo della banca» (write the bank balance). If the balances differ it says «può dipendere da» (may depend on), never «error», and proposes the possible causes it finds in the account's movements (a movement in transit, one recorded twice, the same amount on another account, bank charges not recorded, a movement dated after the statement, the funds' money with several accounts), each with a suggested correction that opens the action already filled in: the administrator always confirms. Each cause can be ignored with a mandatory note, which stays written with the date and who wrote it and can be reopened. The new demo condominium already has the statement balance written.

NEW: CHARGES TO A SINGLE PERSON — A contribution, an already invoiced expense for one person's unit alone, or a late-payment cost is requested from that person only, outside the allocation: from the account statement («Azioni» and the «Addebiti personali» card), from the unassigned-shares panel of a plan or from the «Conguaglio» tab. Each charge is an instalment of a «piano degli addebiti» (charges plan) of the financial year, issued at once with the instalments' accounting entry: so account statement, letters, collection, receipt and portal read it as an instalment. With an invoice, the expense closes the unit's advance and the settlement counts it as already requested, once. A charge can be cancelled as long as it has no movements (with a collection, the collection is reversed first) and cannot be cancelled if a repayment agreement recognises it, if it belongs to a closed year or if it has passed to the heirs: the page says why. If the arrears pass to the heirs, the deceased's open charges go with them. The charges plan is not a plan like the others: it is not generated, recalculated or approved, and the summary has its own line for contributions.

NEW: DEFAULT INTEREST AND LATE-PAYMENT COSTS — From «Rate scadute», «Proponi gli interessi» (propose the interest) computes the interest for the people you choose, instalment by instalment, from the day after the due date, plus the days the regulations allow (or from the day after issue, if the instalment is issued later), up to the day you indicate, in stretches: a stretch splits at every payment, every new year (365 or 366 days) and every new rule, and each line says how it was calculated, with interest rounded to the cent instalment by instalment. The rate is the legal rate of the year (from 2019) or the one written in the condominium's rule. The person's credits and advances cover the oldest instalments first, and interest is computed on the rest; no interest is computed on interest and costs, nor on a tenant's shares (which are counted separately). If a year's rate is missing, the instalment stops and the page says which year is missing. Interest is not added by itself: it becomes a charge only when you record it. Interest and costs without an invoice go to an «Accessori da incassare» (accessories to collect) account and, when the person pays, to the item you choose; in the summary and on the cover page they appear as «Interessi e spese versati dai condòmini» (interest and costs paid by the owners), outside third-party income. In letters the placeholders [interessi], [spese] and [tasso] carry the figures and the rate with its reference. For interest and costs you declare the basis (the law, the regulations, a resolution, a court order, other, none): the program warns you where some rulings see it differently, without blocking you.

NEW: THE DEBT RECOVERY RULES — In the «Condominio» area the «Recupero dei crediti» (debt recovery) page has the condominium's rules, with their history: from when they apply, the rate (the legal rate of the year, or a written rate with its source and reference, which is mandatory and is printed next to the rate), the days after the due date before interest, the tolerance before the reminder and the letters' deadline. On any day only one rule applies, for the whole condominium; without rules the law applies; a rule applies until the day before the next one, and a rule that was never used can be deleted. The legal rate of each year arrives with the update; meanwhile whoever manages the general settings can write by hand the rate of a missing year, with its source, once for all condominiums (if the official one arrives later, it prevails). The page has its own «Guida» button.

NEW: THE REPAYMENT AGREEMENT WITH ITS CALENDAR AND DEFAULT — The agreement has a calendar of instalments (one a month, with the last instalment taking the leftover cents) whose sum must be the acknowledged debt. The money that payments give to the agreement's instalments fills the calendar from the oldest instalment: an instalment is paid only if it is covered in full, with no tolerance, and the program says how much is missing. The agreement's default rule («N unpaid instalments, even non-consecutive» or «G days after an unpaid instalment») raises a signal on the first day it occurs; the program signals, you record the default with «Registra la decadenza» (record the default). While the agreement is in progress (and afterwards, if it has been paid in full), no interest is proposed on the debt it covers; with the default recorded, or once the calendar has ended with unpaid instalments, it comes back into the proposal. The agreement of a deceased person closes «per la successione» (because of the succession) when the arrears pass to the heirs, who each have their own. The agreement's instalments are in the treasury on their dates, and the agreement prints on one page with the calendar.

NEW: «SEI MESI PER AGIRE» AND THE LAWYER'S FILE — On the condominium dashboard the «Sei mesi per agire» (six months to act) panel lists, for each financial year with overdue unpaid instalments, the six-month date, the days left, the people and the amount, and for each person where they stand and the next action the program suggests (for example «Manda la diffida» (send the formal notice) or «Prepara il fascicolo per il legale» (prepare the lawyer's file)): the program suggests, you choose, and it never sends a letter by itself. «Registra che hai agito» (record that you acted) removes the person from the panel and leaves a line with the note; the person returns if a new instalment appears or the amount rises. The panel also reminds you of the financial statement to bring to the assembly within 180 days of the year's end, with «Mettilo in agenda» (put it in the calendar). Instalments without the six-month date open with the people, the reason and the next action («Dichiara l'origine», «Crea l'esercizio»). A person's lawyer's file is a .zip archive with the index, the statement of unpaid instalments, the account statements, the letters with proof of dispatch, the approved financial statement with its minutes and the repayment agreement: by default all overdue instalments, and you remove a year, an instalment or a part; the index says what is there and what is missing, never that it is enough to act. In the six-month exemptions the checkbox «Togli anche il sollecito in tesoreria» (also remove the reminder in the treasury) is off by default.

NEW: «FATTO», «NON SERVE» AND «RICORDAMELO» ON EVERY TASK — Every Inbox task, old and new, is postponed with «Ricordamelo il…» (remind me on…) and, except for the two cases below, is closed with «Fatto, con una nota» (done, with a note) or «Non serve, con il motivo» (not needed, with the reason). A report's task has only «Ricordamelo» (the report is closed from its own page); on a reported bank transfer still being verified «Fatto» is refused and points to «Registra l'incasso», while «Non serve» is the rejection of the report. Every reply leaves in the log who, when and the note, and stays even if the calendar event is deleted after a year. «Ricordamelo» brings the task to the chosen day in the condominium's calendar, at 09:00 (it moves the event; for some kinds, such as deadlines, bank transfers and reports, it writes a separate reminder); for a report's task the reminder says «Riprendi una segnalazione» (resume a report) and the condominium, without the subject, because the firm's calendar is also read by people who cannot see the reports.

NEW: THE CONDOMINIUM SETTINGS — In the «Condominio» area there is the «Impostazioni» (settings) tab, with two switches that apply to that condominium only: «Una rata nuova non fa tornare indietro» (a new instalment does not send you back; on, by default: after a reminder letter whose deadline has passed the program proposes the formal notice, and after the formal notice the lawyer's file, even if a new instalment falls due meanwhile; off: for instalments that fell due after the letter it proposes the same letter again) and «Il programma suggerisce la prossima azione» (the program suggests the next action; off, each person only has «Scegli l'azione»). Under each switch an «Adesso: …» (now) line says what happens with the choice made, before saving. The tab has the three cards, the hints and its own guide.

NEW: THE 30-DAY TREASURY — On the condominium dashboard the «Saldo previsto» (forecast balance) is viewed in three scenarios: «Senza le rate» (only invoices and movements already recorded), «Con le rate in scadenza» (with the instalments falling due) and «Se pagano tutti» (everyone pays, including instalments already overdue, as of today); the traffic light does not follow the choice. «Fatture in scadenza» (invoices due) has «Paga» (pay) and the due date; «Rate scadute dei condòmini» (overdue instalments of the owners) has for each person the right action (record the collection, offset, or the reminder), and above eight people it shows the first five and «Vedi tutte le rate scadute →». The «azioni consigliate» (recommended actions) button opens a drawer with the situation in one sentence, the chart with the three lines and the simulation («quanto recuperi delle rate già scadute», how much you recover of the overdue instalments), and the actions, computed with fixed rules (eight kinds): the withholdings to pay with the F24, the owners' reported bank transfers to verify (including those set aside with «Ricordamelo», saying until when), the instalments not yet issued that fall due within 30 days or are already overdue, the recovery of overdue instalments (with «Registra gli incassi» next to the reminder), the invoices to move after the instalments come in, a transfer between an account below zero and one with money, the release of a tied fund that the assembly may resolve, and «even if everyone pays the account stays below zero». The program proposes, it does not act: with the switch «Il programma suggerisce la prossima azione» off (condominium settings) the actions do not appear and the button becomes «Simula il saldo» (simulate the balance). «Emetti le rate» (issue the instalments) opens a window with the plan, the instalments (those already overdue and those of the next 30 days are ticked), the date, «Avvisa i condòmini» (notify the owners) and the summary: it issues like the plan's page, with the same refusals.

NEW: THE REDESIGNED ACTION INBOX AND REPORT TASKS — The Action inbox has five filter cards («Scaduti», «Prossimi 7 giorni», «Bonifici segnalati», «Segnalazioni», «Sei mesi»), the task list with the «Tutti», «Scaduti», «In arrivo» tabs, search and sorting, and on the right the charts «Da quanto aspettano» and «Per tipo», «Sei mesi per agire» for all condominiums (the drawer opens with «Apri l'elenco») and «Dove si accumulano». Instead of «Risolvi», each task has its next action («Emetti la rata», «Registra gli incassi», «Paga la fattura»…). Every open report has its task in the Inbox, and it closes with the report (thanks to Web Pro Italia for the idea): the next action is «Approva o rifiuta» (approve or reject) while the report awaits approval, then «Apri la segnalazione» (open the report); tasks show «urgente» or «alta»; the «⋯» menu only has «Ricordamelo». The condominium's operational Inbox follows the same rules, with the «Tutte», «Scadute», «In arrivo» tabs changing only the panel.

NEW: THE GUIDES — The condominium dashboard, each of the eight financial statement tabs, «Recupero dei crediti», «Impostazioni», «Incasso da terzi», the person's account statement, the fund page and the Action inbox have the «Guida» button with the drawer: each guide explains what the page really does.

NEW: THE LICENCE — The new files and those touched by this version carry the header with the AGPL-3.0-or-later licence and the author's name, and the NOTICE file adds the terms of section 7(b) and 7(c): the three header lines are kept in every copy, the interface keeps «KondoManager» visible with the link to the source, and a modified version is marked as different from the original.

FIXED: A REPORTED BANK TRANSFER NO LONGER STAYS «IN VERIFICATION» — If the administrator records the collection from «Registra l'incasso» and the money goes to other (older) instalments, the instalment the owner reported no longer stays «in verification» for ever: it goes back to due, or shows as paid or partly paid, and the portal says where the payment went, with the instalments and amounts. The owner can report again an instalment that went back to due. Instalments left stuck before the update fix themselves. The links of the Inbox tasks no longer depend on the site address they were written with.

FIXED: OTHER POINTS — A payment to a supplier, new or edited, really checks the IBAN against the supplier's and asks for confirmation if it differs (when editing, if the IBAN changes). In the «Conguaglio per persona» print the figures from the fifth row down sit under their headings. The demo condominium is created with the financial year written in the instalment plan. The settlement's sentences no longer promise «l'amministratore completerà la cifra» (the administrator will complete the figure).
